fields.description: RFC 5322 Message-Id (or an inbound-adapter id when absent).

The primary recipient the message was routed on. Usually NOT helpful: for forwarded mail it shows the internal address the user forwarded it to (e.g. their Listen-Fire forwarding address), not the true recipient. Prefer `From` for who the message is about.

answer.text: Email sent to your inbound address starts this automation. Forward or CC it to route a message into your movement.

transcript.answer: Fires once per email actually delivered to the movement's dedicated forwarding address (inbox+<key>@example.com) — it does NOT read an existing inbox or see mail sent elsewhere. The user must forward or send mail to that address for it to fire; the listen key is the plus-suffix, so different keys route different mail. Describe it as "when an email is sent to your inbound address", not "when you get an email".
